messages:
Emily H.: FYI — Customer (acct 0x9f4b) says their promotional bonus credits dropped to 0 during a failed card retry and the promo expired automatically. They want a one-off extension.
Sara (CS): Can you paste the account ID + promo code and the exact expiration timestamp? We need that to check policy.
Emily H.: account: `0x9f4b`
promo: `WELCOME-2024-50`
expired_at: 2026-01-27T14:03:12Z
Customer says they had a charge attempt then card declined, then they updated card 3 days later — saw credits gone.
Sara (CS): Thanks. Per policy, trial/promo credits auto-expire at the listed timestamp; manual extensions are allowed case-by-case for billing failures within 7 days if Finance signs off. Escalating.
Jordan T.: tagging @Alex (Billing Ops) — I pulled the ledger: promo applied 2025-11-27, 50 credit units, unused. There was a payment_retry event 2026-01-25 then subsequent card_update on 2026-01-28 (outside 7d window?). However the retry loop included a gateway error on 2026-01-26 which flagged the account for auto-expire cleanup job at 2026-01-27 14:00 UTC.
Alex (Billing Ops): Understood. Do we have the customer's business case? If they updated the card within 48–72h, we often reinstate. If update was after cleanup job, we need Finance approval. What's the impact (prod outage / P1)?
Emily H.: Not P1, but they're mid-loadtest and it blocked devs. Customer asks for credits so tests can continue.
Jordan T.: I created CS ticket CS-21987 and billing ops task BO-4481. Added ledger snapshot and cleanup job logs.
finance-bot: NOTE: Request BO-4481 queued for manual review by finance-ops. Please include amount to reinstate and justification.
Alex (Billing Ops): Suggested amount: reapply 50 promo units and set expiry to 2026-03-01 to allow them to finish tests. Need a short justification from CS (one sentence).
Sara (CS): Emily, please add a one-line justification to CS-21987 and request a 50-unit reapply. I'll ping Finance.
Emily H.: Done — "Customer load tests blocked due to credits auto-expiring during card retry; requesting 50-unit one-off reinstatement to allow completion of contracted evaluation." Added to CS-21987.
Jordan T.: Finance accepted provisional reapply pending fraud check. If clear, we'll push credit and update account metadata.
Alex (Billing Ops): Marking BO-4481 -> in_progress. ETA for manual apply: ~2 hours. Will update CS-21987 when applied.
Sara (CS): Thanks everyone. Emily, can you follow up with customer once applied and ask them to confirm tests complete so we can close the ticket? :thumbsup:
Emily H.: Will do.
finance-bot: ACTION: credits_reapplied 50 units to account `0x9f4b` by BO-4481 at 1767348958.
Alex (Billing Ops): Done — pushed credits, extended expiry to 2026-03-01. Noted in CS-21987 and BO-4481.
Emily H.: Customer confirmed tests completed. Closing loop. Thanks! :tada:
